title: Layer 1: Hormuz Direct Indicators

desc: Core variables driving the entire chain
desc_zh: 所有逻辑链的第一推动力

warRiskPremium.note: PREMIUM SPIKING: Ceasefire MOU completely collapsed Jun 26-28. US-Iran exchanging active military strikes. Strait under active combat operations. Premium likely surging well above prior 1% level as insurers reassess total loss risk. War risk premiums for Hormuz transits now 5-10x baseline as underwriters pull coverage. Updated 2026-06-28
warRiskPremium.note_zh: 保费飙升中：6月26-28日停火MOU完全崩溃。美伊进行中的军事打击。海峡处于作战状态。保费可能远超此前1%水平，承保人正在撤销海峡通航保险。更新于 2026-06-28

straitThroughput.note: CEASEFIRE COLLAPSED: Iranian drone attacked cargo ship in Strait of Hormuz Jun 26. US struck multiple IRGC targets in Iran Jun 27. IRGC retaliated, striking US sites in Gulf — drones targeted Bahrain. US carried out FRESH strikes Jun 28 against Iran after another tanker struck. Strait effectively under active military operations. Oil prices spiking. UN launches Hormuz evacuation plan. Updated 2026-06-28
straitThroughput.note_zh: 停火崩溃：6月26日伊朗无人机攻击霍尔木兹海峡货船。6月27日美军打击伊朗IRGC多处目标。IRGC报复打击海湾美方目标——无人机攻击巴林。6月28日美军再度打击伊朗。海峡实质处于作战状态。油价飙升。联合国启动霍尔木兹撤离计划。更新于 2026-06-28

irgcStatementFreq.note: CEASEFIRE COLLAPSED: IRGC issued retaliation statement Jun 27 after US strikes. 'If aggression repeated, response will be broader' — IRGC Telegram. Drone attacks on US sites in Gulf. JD Vance: 'Violence will be met with violence'. Active military communications between US CENTCOM and IRGC via Swiss channel. Escalation ladder: drone attack >> US strikes >> IRGC retaliation >> fresh US strikes. Updated 2026-06-28
irgcStatementFreq.note_zh: 停火崩溃：6月27日美军打击后IRGC发布报复声明。'如侵略再犯，回应将更广泛'——IRGC Telegram频道。无人机攻击海湾美方目标。万斯：'暴力必以暴力回应'。美伊通过瑞士渠道进行军事通信。升级阶梯：无人机攻击>>美军打击>>IRGC报复>>美军再次打击。更新于 2026-06-28

fleetPosition.value: Active strikes — CENTCOM conducting operations against IRGC targets
fleetPosition.note: MAJOR SHIFT: US 5th fleet went from anchored deterrent posture to ACTIVE STRIKES. CENTCOM confirmed strikes on IRGC missile, drone storage, and coastal radar positions Jun 27. Fresh strikes Jun 28 after another tanker hit. Iranian drones targeted Bahrain in retaliation. Fleet now in combat operations, not patrol. UN launches evacuation plan. Updated 2026-06-28
fleetPosition.note_zh: 重大转变：美第5舰队从锚泊威慑转为实战打击。CENTCOM确认6月27日打击IRGC导弹、无人机仓库和海岸雷达站。6月28日再打击。伊朗无人机报复性攻击巴林。舰队现在处于作战状态。联合国启动撤离计划。更新于 2026-06-28

saudiUaeStance.value: Saudi supporting US strikes, GCC cohesion tested
saudiUaeStance.value_zh: 沙特支持美方打击，GCC凝聚力受考验
saudiUaeStance.threshold_zh: 自行其是 = 同盟裂痕
saudiUaeStance.note: Saudi Cabinet chaired by MBS welcomed original US-Iran agreement. Now with collapsed ceasefire and active US-Iran strikes, Saudi faces: (1) Iranian drones targeting Bahrain - direct GCC threat, (2) Hajj 2026 security concerns, (3) Saudi hosting role in any new talks. Saudi seen backing US strikes. UAE position unchanged. OPEC+ production decisions pending. Updated 2026-06-28
saudiUaeStance.note_zh: MBS主持的沙特内阁欢迎美伊初步协议。现停火崩溃、美伊实战，沙特面临：(1)伊朗无人机攻击巴林——直接威胁GCC，(2)2026年朝觐安全，(3)沙特在新谈判中的调解角色。沙特被认为支持美方打击。阿联酋立场未变。OPEC+产量决策待定。更新于 2026-06-28
